prose.description: The most common people of the world, found in every faction and every land. Greenlanders have no special strengths or weaknesses, and they shape themselves to wherever they live: a Greenlander of the Holy Nation and one of the United Cities can seem like different peoples. The Holy Nation counts them as true humans.
prose.speech: Varies with upbringing more than with race: pious in the Holy Nation, mercenary in the United Cities, wary on the open road.
